title: Trump’s fixation, invasive species, world’s coolest neighborhood: Catch up on the day’s stories | CNN
text:
👋Welcome to 5 Things PM!What does it take to be named the world’s coolest neighborhood?This year’s winneris a vibrant foodie hub known for its amazing street eats and independent businesses.

Here’s what else you might have missed during your busy day.

President Donald Trump has been preoccupied with the Kennedy Center’s programming, his hand-picked board of trustees, renovations and insisting his name belongs on the building. CNN’s Aaron Blake says it shows how consumed the president iswith his own glorification.

➕ Is the Kennedy Center closed?Question hangs over arts institution as judge orders update

💬 CNN Office Hours:Share your midterms questions and join the conversation live this evening at 7 p.m. ET

Cigarettes don’t just cause lung cancer. The toxic smoke affects nearly every organ in the body and can lead to heart attacks and strokes. A doctor explainswhat you need to know.

Most content creators are out to make a killing. For Nate Sorensen, the killing is the point.He’s going to waragainst an invasive species that is destroying Florida’s coral reefs.

Thousands of student athletes are returning to their college teams this fall. Earning a spot on the roster, or an athletic scholarship, takes years of hard work — and thousands of dollars.Let’s break it down.

Gigantic insects. Loft parties. Freaky footwear. New York Fashion Week leaned into the fun and fabulous — and of course there was some drama along the way.Check out the best looks.

⛰️ Dramatic rescue:A helicopter crewpulled a climber to safetyfrom the Sierra Nevada’s towering “Power Dome” after he became stranded on the nearly vertical rock face.

🫁 Lungs at work:A stunning video capturing intricate cell movement in a child living with a rare genetic disorder won the Nikon Small World in Motion competition.Take a look.

EDITOR’S NOTE:Interested in exclusive stories like these?Choose a plan

🎵 Which musician’s “Free Palestine” comments caused him to be dropped from Ed Sheeran’s US tour dates?

A. Eminem

B. Macklemore

C. Robbie Williams

D. Rufus Wainwright

⬇️Scroll down for the answer.

✅Most popular in yesterday’s newsletter:Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations after chaotic call with Trump

🧠Quiz answer: B.Sheeran’s international tour has been thrown into crisis, with all of the British singer’s other opening acts quittingto protest Macklemore’s removal.

👋 We’ll see you tomorrow.

Today’s edition of 5 Things PM was edited and produced by CNN’s Kimberly Richardson and Chris Good.
